title: Help System Creates Feedback Loop for Wheel Improvement
description: Help is an internal agent capability (not user-facing) that enables agents to discover local knowledge, navigate the registry, and surface gaps. Unanswered questions create lugs that show the wheel what's missing.
perceive: Agents need to: (1) know what they know locally, (2) find who specializes in what, (3) ask the right expert, (4) surface gaps
execute: Implemented help as framework/skills/help.yaml. Agents use it internally to navigate registry, discover expertise, and create lugs when answers aren't found.
verify: Help enables feedback loop: agent finds gap → lug created → receiver sees gap → improves → next agent benefits
why_not_user_facing: User experience is simple: 'Agent, do X'. Agent internally uses help to navigate. No user sees /help prompts or registry details.
